beats.text: Netherlands has 83.3 percent active youth. Djibouti has 13.4 percent.
Djibouti is the world's lowest. It counts everyone who supplies labor.
USA has 50.8 percent and China has 49.3 percent.
Nigeria has 64.8 percent, 3.9 times the proportion in Libya.
Climbing higher: Australia 70.2 percent, Madagascar 72.4 percent, and Iceland 82.1 percent.
Netherlands is the world's highest: 83.3 percent are active.
What keeps youth active in the labor force where you live?
